tasks.short: Maintain current nursing knowledge through reading and professional exchange

steps.what: Read current literature and assess developments relevant to nursing practice
Discuss developments with colleagues and participate in professional organizations or conferences

tasks.design: Retain critical reading through {DOCS} and direct professional exchange. A generated digest may aid orientation, but it does not replace reading evidence or conference participation and no separate search baseline is established here.
tasks.previous_blocker: Clinical learning requires assessing methods, limits and relevance.
tasks.enabler_now: Information tools help access without proving that shorter reading preserves understanding.
tasks.still_hard: New findings may conflict with established practice or apply to different patients.
tasks.human_edge: The practitioner questions evidence and tests its relevance with experienced colleagues.
tasks.altitude: Professional learning time and clinical decision rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Discuss an emerging practice question with the team

evidence.claim: Retaining critical reading and professional participation is an E1 assessment from model knowledge; general clinical scribes do not establish learning-time reductions.

assumptions: Boundary is reading, discussion and professional participation, excluding separate literature search or report-writing work unless measured independently.
No structured clinically-applicable or trustworthy-study flag is assumed; the practitioner assesses the original material.
Existing document and professional access remain; no custom learning tool proposed.
Zero upkeep because no workflow changes. Disagree with the amplification prior where it would remove learning itself.
unknowns: Learning requirements, access and actual separate search effort
research_questions: Does any measured repetitive discovery work exist outside critical reading and participation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0; reading for understanding and professional exchange remain fully counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Instruct clinical staff in anaesthesia and emergency responses

steps.what: Instruct nurses, residents, interns, students and staff in anesthetic techniques and emergency responses

tasks.design: Keep clinical instruction, demonstration and corrective feedback with the qualified practitioner. Approved methods in {DOCS} support teaching; generated lesson text does not establish safe anaesthetic or emergency technique.
tasks.previous_blocker: Clinical technique and response need observed practice and context-specific feedback.
tasks.enabler_now: Document tools do not replace qualified clinical teaching.
tasks.still_hard: A learner can describe a procedure while missing critical cues in practice.
tasks.human_edge: The instructor notices misconceptions and intervenes before unsafe practice continues.
tasks.altitude: Instruction responsibility and time stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Keeping observed clinical instruction human is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is instruction delivery and feedback, excluding course authoring, certification administration and learner labour.
No free structured competence flag or automatic clinical certification is assumed.
Current approved guidance remains; no custom training system proposed.
Zero upkeep because no workflow changes; national trainer and professional requirements need confirmation.
unknowns: Teaching responsibilities and required practical assessments
research_questions: Which learner misconceptions require direct demonstration rather than written explanation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0; instruction and feedback retain full time with no invented lesson-production share.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Protect critical learning and observed clinical instruction without claiming capacity from those activities.
reach: Discuss emerging evidence with clinical educators
role.ambitious_version: A practitioner who tests new evidence carefully and develops colleagues through clear explanation and observed practice.
